title: GeneratedTestCase
description: Schema for a single generated, validated API test case emitted by specprobe generate

operation_id.description: Traceable operationId or method/path identifier of the target API operation

description.description: Plain-language description of the happy-path scenario tested

request.description: Concrete fixtures proposed for the HTTP request

path_params.description: Key-value mapping of path template parameter replacements

query_params.description: Key-value mapping of query string parameters

body.description: Request body payload conforming to the operation schema

schema_shape.description: Expected response JSON schema shape or structural property assertions

tags.description: Operational tags inherited from the OpenAPI specification
